before: Trades are allowed during the regular season until July 31, and re-open after the Korean Series. Other clubs judge trades by public ratings (current and potential value, age, contract length, salary) and only accept if incoming value slightly exceeds outgoing value. Foreign players and rookies drafted in the current year cannot be traded. Cash considerations (one side only, up to {money}, where ₩100M ≈ 1 value) and upcoming draft picks (only alongside players, up to 2 picks per club per year per KBO rules) may be included.
